mods.name: PC Plus+
mods.description: Easily filter your PC boxes for Legendaries, Shinies, HAs, specific Types, and more! Now with Combo Filtering and the Group Update: see a green + next to other PC Plus+ users in the tab list and above their heads.

releases.notes:
1.0.6 – The Group Update
See other PC Plus+ users: a green + now appears next to the name of every other PC Plus+ user in the multiplayer tab list.
In-world marker: the same green + floats above a player's head when you walk near them.
Works on any server: the + marker shows up on every multiplayer server you join — no server-side install required.

mods.name: PC Plus+
mods.description:
Everyone who plays Pixelmon can agree that sorting your PC can be a challenge. Well, I have got the solution! 

You can now easily filter boxes using custom UI buttons for L100, HA, Shiny, Gen 1-9 Legendaries, and NOW specific Pokemon Types! Includes brand-new level 100 search logic and up-to-date Gen 9 Paradox support.

NEW IN 1.0.4:
- Dual-Type Filtering: A brand new "TYPES" drop-down menu! Scroll through all 18 types and click up to two of them (like Fire and Flying) to instantly find exactly what you are looking for. 

EXISTING FEATURES:
- Mass Multi-Select & Move: Hold Ctrl and click to grab multiple Pokémon at once and move them to new boxes instantly!
- Mass Delete: Safely wipe out boxes of junk Pokémon in seconds.
- Valuables Protection: A built-in scanner stops you from accidentally deleting Legendaries, Mythicals, Ultra Beasts, HAs, 100 IVs, or Textured Pokémon.
- Custom Keybinds: Change the multi-select key to whatever you want in the Minecraft Controls menu.

releases.notes:
Changelog - v1.0.4 Update
New Features:

Added the "TYPES" Dropdown Menu: You can now open a brand-new menu directly in the PC to filter by all 18 Pokémon types. You can even select up to two types at once (e.g., Fire + Flying) to find exact dual-type matches!

Stackable Search Filters: You can finally combine filters! You can now have a custom button active (like @ legendary or @ shiny) and select types from the new menu at the same time to narrow down your searches even further.

Bug Fixes & Improvements:

Fixed Search Bar Truncation: Greatly increased the maximum character limit of the search box. Long combined queries (like @ legendary @ type:electric,flying) will no longer get randomly cut off by the game.

Fixed Text Shifting Bug: Patched an issue where the search box text would slide to the left and hide the first few letters of your query when clicking buttons.

General stability improvements for the UI overlay.

releases.notes:
Changelog:

⚙️ New Features & Improvements:

Custom Keybinds Added! You can now fully customize the Multi-Select / Multi-Delete keybind. Just go to your Minecraft Options -> Controls, scroll down to the "PC Plus+" category, and set it to whatever key fits your playstyle!

New Default Key (Ctrl + Click): The default multi-select key has been changed from Shift to Left Control. This makes grabbing and moving multiple Pokémon feel much faster and more natural—just like selecting files on your real-life computer!

🌟 Community Shoutout:

A massive shoutout to MarkoGazz for suggesting the switch from Shift to Ctrl! Thank you for the amazing feedback that helps make this mod better for everyone.

releases.notes:
Release Name: PC Plus+ v1.0.1 - The Mass Deletion Update! Changelog:

🎉 New Features:

Added Mass Multi-Delete: You can now shift-click to select multiple Pokémon and delete them all at once! Perfect for instantly clearing out boxes of breedjects.

Added Valuables Protection Scanner: Don't worry about accidental clicks! The new mass-delete feature includes a built-in safety scanner. It will automatically detect and stop you from accidentally trashing Legendaries, Mythicals, Ultra Beasts, Hidden Abilities (HA), 100 IVs, or Textured Pokémon.

🐛 Bug Fixes & Improvements:

Fixed a visual glitch where the green selection highlights would snap to the wrong grid slots after closing the search menu. Highlights now perfectly track your Pokémon back to their true boxes!

Rewrote the selection handling to perfectly track Pokémon by their exact server UUIDs, making multi-grabbing completely accurate and much faster.
